A_clean_glyph_program.generator: per-glyph 256px clean render + topology signature; full stage adds template shortlist, variant labels, SDF/corner targets (audit S10 Stage A)

B_clean_line_layout.generator: variable length 1-32, dynamic width, oracle transcript + oracle boxes from the vector font source

D_degradation_inverse.generator: blur/JPEG/gamma/resampling over Stage B/C corpora; renderer family held out per audit S11.4

E_ocr_uncertainty.generator: N-best transcripts, token posteriors, corrupted flags (audit S13; hard-wrong-token forbidden per Experiment E)

note: Only Stage A carries a materialized attested payload; stages B-E are generator specs gated on their prerequisites; stage F is blocked on the human capacity decision. The readiness gate must not read 'defined' as 'materialized'.
